trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Faridabad (T.A.No. 251 of 2023)
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Parties were married in 2018 and have a minor child. Petitioner-wife is living separately from respondent-husband and seeking transfer of his petition under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act to a court at Palwal.

legal_principles.principle: The cardinal principle for exercise of power under section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure is that the ends of justice should demand the transfer of the suit, appeal or other proceeding.
legal_principles.held: In matrimonial matters, wherever Courts are called upon to consider the plea of transfer, the Courts have to take into consideration the economic soundness of both the parties, the social strata of the spouses and their behavioural pattern, their standard of life prior to the marriage and subsequent thereto and the circumstances of both the parties in eking out their livelihood.
cited_cases: N.C.V. Aishwarya vs A.S. Saravana Karthik, (2022) Live Law (SC) 627

legal_principles.principle: In considering the transfer of a matrimonial dispute/case, at the instance of the wife, the Court is to consider the family condition of the wife, the custody of the minor child, economic condition of the wife, her physical health and earning capacity of the husband.
legal_principles.held: The Courts should desist from putting female litigants under undue hardships.
cited_cases: Sumita Singh vs Kumar Sanjay, (2002) SC 396
Rajani Kishor Pardeshi vs Kishor Babulal Pardeshi, (2005) (12) SCC 237

outcome.final_order: Petition transferred to a court at Palwal.
